node.title: Conjecture-F higher-weight sparse Face-4 payment
node.statement: In the proper gcd-trivial Conjecture-F regime, after the proved sparse-rank split removes bounded rank and abundant weight two, every growing support-minimal weight-at-least-three branch transported to Face 4 is either assigned canonically to a tangent, multiplicative-pullback, or dihedral owner, or undergoes strict descent whose complete first-owner descendants have total unpaid population at most n^B_hw for one absolute exponent. Routing to Face 4 or classifying a local circuit is not itself payment.
node.attack_surface: retain actual locator-section membership and first ownership through the syzygy-flat transport; aggregate support embeddings and cross-core multiplicity rather than counting local charts
node.falsifier: a proper gcd-trivial flat family with growing higher-weight sparse span, no paid owner, and super-polynomially many actual unpaid section points or descendants
